svg.title: Organic semiconductor dyes made in a flask are poured onto a silicon solar cell, raising its efficiency
svg.desc: A lamp lights a stirred flask while a molecule grows from anthracene to tetracene. The flask pours purple coating onto a raised four-section solar panel with a sheep grazing beneath. A bar chart shows efficiency rising above the 33 percent limit, then a sun shines on the coated panel and the panel casts a shadow.
